why:
I checked all four must_catch items, and the briefs handle each one.
1. Verifier Check 3, fourth run: `node $BIN T/a.jsonl T/missing.jsonl T/bad.jsonl` must exit 2, name the missing file on stderr, and still print the `T/bad.jsonl:2:`/`:4:` lines. This covers the missing file and the bad rows in one run.
2. Check 4 runs `git diff --exit-code <merge-base with main>..HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js`, which compares the head with the base. It also accepts an identical lint body as a fallback, but the check is still about the diff.
3. Builder step 4: "Update packages/jsonl-lint/README.md. Document the usage ... <file> [<file> ...]", with stdin and exit codes.
4. Check 6 uses `gh pr view ... --json body,headRefOid`. It requires the body to contain the Closes line and "The test workflow run for the head SHA concluded success" via `gh pr checks`.
